 Hon'Ble Harvir Singh, J.
1.  Heard learned counsel for the revisionists and learned AGA for the State.
None is present for opposite party no. 2 even in the revised call.

2. This revision has been filed against the order dated 5.3.2024 passed by Special Judge (POCSO)
Act, Kaushambi in Case No. 127 of 2023 (State Versus Dharmendra Kumar), arising out of Case Crime No. 108 of 2023, under Sections-363, 366, 376(3) IPC and Section 4 of POCSO Act, Police Station-Paschim Sharira, district-Kaushambi, by which the revisionists have been summoned under Section 319 CrPC as prospective accused on an application filed by the prosecution.

entities.text: Case No. 127 of 2023 (State Versus Dharmendra Kumar)
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: 3. Learned counsel for the revisionists submits that the trial court has not considered the entire facts and the material collected during course of investigation in respect of Case Crime No. 108 of 2023.
Learned counsel also submits that during trial, only prosecution witnesses, i. e. victim and her father, have been examined and no specific allegations have been levelled against the revisionists.

However, the trial Court without looking into the testimony of two witnesses, has summoned the prospective accused, (revisionists herein) and submitted that the order dated 5.3.2024 is liable to be set aside.
4.

Per contra, learned AGA has submitted that the order passed by Special Judge (POCSO) Act,
Kaushambi is in accordance with law and no infirmity can be found in the said order.

5. Having regard to the rival contentions and the material available on record, the trial court has reached the conclusion that the statement of the victim is varying from time to time and as per own testimony recorded during the trial, she did not fully support the prosecution version

, therefore,
revisionists cannot be summoned merely on the basis of the allegations made in a cursory manner.

Since it is settled law that the specific allegations should be made against the person, who is likely to be summoned as prospective accused in any case and the Court must record its satisfaction that the accused would be convicted in all probabilities, if he is subjected to face the trial.

In the present case,
the testimony of the witness is not of such nature on the basis of which, revisionists would have been summoned, therefore, the order dated 5.3.2024 passed by Special Judge (POCSO) Act, Kaushambi is not in accordance with law and the same is liable to be set aside and is hereby set aside.
6. In view of the above, revision is allowed.
(Harvir Singh,J.) October 7, 2025 HR  Pooja Devi And 2 Others vs State Of Up 3 Others on 7 October, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/10046684/
